name: Underwater Dome
living: the whales glide slowly across the dome, their tails beating gently
schools of glowing fish swirl and drift past the glass
shafts of blue-green light sway down from the surface
caustic light ripples dance softly across the field
the kelp forest sways in the current
strings of bubbles rise slowly past the dome
warm windows in the sunken city flicker on and off
the scoreboard's night-city screen twinkles and its clock hands tick
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe in the water haze
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
